lines.en: I squirm forward slowly.

lines.zh: 我的身体是软的，走路没声音。
lines.en: My body is soft and my steps make no sound.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的泥里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the swamp mud.

lines.zh: 我一边爬，一边留下一条黏痕。
lines.en: I leave a slimy trail as I crawl.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在背上一转一转。
lines.en: My eyes swivel on my back.
I squeeze under a root.
I move slowly toward the wood.
A few stalks of grass cling to me.
I crawl over a patch of rotten leaves.

lines.zh: 我的脚很短，走一步晃一下。
lines.en: My legs are stubby and I wobble each step.

lines.zh: 我在泥里停了停，又往前。
lines.en: I pause in the mud, then go on.

lines.zh: 我朝有粪便气味的地方去。
lines.en: I head for the smell of dung.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转到树干后面。
lines.en: I shift slowly behind a trunk.

lines.zh: 我这一身，走到哪儿都留印。
lines.en: This body leaves a mark wherever it goes.
I lie in the mud and breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水是温的，很舒服。
lines.en: The swamp water is warm and comfortable.
Flies are circling my head.

lines.zh: 我把一团东西捧在手里。
lines.en: I hold a lump of something in my hands.
Numbers keep rolling in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我慢慢嚼着嘴里那点东西。
lines.en: Slowly I chew what is in my mouth.
I am used to the smell here.
There is a wound on my body.
I lift a hand and look at it.
An insect has climbed onto my back.

lines.zh: 我在林子的锚点附近待着。
lines.en: I stay near my anchor in the wood.

lines.zh: 我挪了一下，泥被压出坑。
lines.en: I shift and the mud takes a hollow.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚从泥里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull one foot out of the mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面上浮着一层绿。
lines.en: Green scum floats on the swamp water.
You look stronger than I am.
Do not hit me. I am of little use.

lines.zh: 我这一身不太好看，我知道。
lines.en: This body is not pleasant. I know.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的袋子，鼓鼓的。
lines.en: The bag at your belt looks stuffed.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，可我会扔东西。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I can throw.

lines.zh: 你退开一点，我身上有味道。
lines.en: Step back. I carry an odor.

lines.zh: 我在这片沼泽游荡很久了。
lines.en: I have wandered this swamp a long while.
You laughed. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛多，看的方向也多。
lines.en: I have many eyes and they look many ways.

lines.zh: 我这一身软壳，谁看了都皱眉。
lines.en: This soft body makes everyone frown.
When hungry I eat anything.

lines.zh: 你身上有股干净的味道。
lines.en: You smell clean.

lines.zh: 你要站远些，我身上会沾。
lines.en: Stand further off. I will soil you.
Gel all over. No hurry.
Do not watch me. Watch the mud.

lines.zh: 我这一身，只有沼泽不嫌弃。
lines.en: Only the swamp tolerates this body.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在我软壳上，很疼。
lines.en: That blow lands on my soft shell, and it hurts.
I back half a block and crouch.
A hollow has been pressed into me.

lines.zh: 黏液混着血，从我身上淌下。
lines.en: Slime and blood run down my body.
It hurts too much to turn my eyes.

lines.zh: 鼻涕兽的皮，软得塌下去。
lines.en: Numemon hide sags soft.
I can bear this much.
I shift back to get away.
I keep that in the mud.
I have not fallen.
What is that? Is it edible?
I smell something I could eat.
I inch over, slowly.

lines.zh: 这味儿，我在粪堆里闻过。
lines.en: This smell — I've met it in a dung heap.
I open my mouth and eat it.
One taste. It is edible.
Do you have more? I am still hungry.
Soft and limp, even crawling is hard.

lines.zh: 这一小口，填不了我的肚子。
lines.en: That little bite won't fill me.
Afterward I lick my hands clean.
I do not care if it is dirty.
Lower it and I can reach.
You bumped me and I wobbled twice.
I am slippery. Your hands will get it.
I shrink back and the mud squelches aside.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我软软地黏住你的手。
lines.en: You bump into me and my soft body sticks to your hand.
I am soft, and I am heavy.
You stepped in my slime.
That made me list to one side.

lines.zh: 我把黏糊糊的身子挪开一点。
lines.en: I shift my slimy bulk aside.
I'm too slimy to squeeze past.
Your boot print is on me now.
There are a few of my kind in this swamp.
We do not think much of each other.
One of them is dirtier than I.
We wander on our own sides.

lines.zh: 有粪便的地方，我们都会去。
lines.en: Where there is dung, we all go.
Nobody takes from anyone.
Once we crowded into one spot.
Even I could not stand the smell.
Afterward we scattered.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽够我们几个待。
lines.en: This swamp holds us all.
There is a lump on the ground.
I scoop it up and eat.
Too hard. I put it down.
I found something I can throw.

lines.zh: 这枚亮东西，不知道是什么。
lines.en: A bright thing. I do not know what it is.
I stuff it into my mouth to keep.
My hands are all mud.
Slime-slick hands can't get a grip.
I throw it back.

lines.zh: 我用鼻涕把地上那团粘起来。
lines.en: I glue that lump off the ground with my slime.

lines.zh: 沼泽对面有个影子在晃。
lines.en: Something shifts across the swamp.

lines.zh: 我把多只眼睛都转向它。
lines.en: I turn all my eyes toward it.
It's shorter than me; I can hit it.
I have a lump in my hand.
I can throw that far.
It has not noticed me.
I shift out of the mud.
I raise my hand a little.
It has turned away.
Its back is turned; I raise my arm.

lines.zh: 手里这团粪，我算好距离了。
lines.en: This lump of dung is measured for the throw.

lines.zh: 它站在干地上，正好能扔到。
lines.en: It stands on dry ground, right in throwing range.
I shift along after it.
I crawl slowly, and I am sticky.
I am a few blocks behind.

lines.zh: 我把手里那团东西捏紧。
lines.en: I squeeze the lump in my hand.
It turns its head; I sink into the mud.
It has not noticed me.
I edge half a block closer.
I raise my hand to shoulder height.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的泥里爬出来，它转过身。
lines.en: I crawl out of the swamp mud, and it turns away.
I swing my arm.
I slow my steps further.
It stands on a dry patch.
I throw the lump.
It strikes the thing squarely.
My throw went wide.
I scoop up another lump.
That one catches its shoulder.
It rushes and I back away.
I push at its leg.
The smell makes it step back.
I throw again.
Its clothes are soiled now.
I let out a laugh. A foolish one.
It covers its nose and leaves.

lines.zh: 我从沼泽的烂泥里拱出来。
lines.en: I heave myself out of the swamp muck.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水从我身上流下。
lines.en: Swamp water runs off me.
I like the smell of this place.
I stop beside a tree root.
My eyes turn first.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，看了看，鼻涕还挂着。
lines.en: I raise my hand to look; slime still hangs from it.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽有我待的地方。
lines.en: There is room for me in this swamp.

lines.zh: 我的身体一沉，泥就陷下去。
lines.en: I settle and the mud sinks.
Flies arrive at once.
I move slowly toward the wood.
The sun on the swamp is close and heavy.

lines.zh: 我从烂泥里抬头，嗅了嗅风。
lines.en: I lift my head from the muck and sniff the wind.

lines.zh: 这附近应该有吃的东西。
lines.en: There should be something to eat nearby.

lines.zh: 我先在这棵烂树根边歇着。
lines.en: I'll rest by this rotting root for now.
Fire came and I rolled into the mud.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下，摔进泥潭。
lines.en: I slid off the bank into the mud pool.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进嘴里，我呛住了。
lines.en: Muddy water filled my mouth and I choked.
The blast flipped me into the mud.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的身体。
lines.en: Something is stuck in me.
That strange light — I cannot break free.

lines.zh: 什么都没有，我越来越没力气。
lines.en: Nothing to eat. I grow weaker.

lines.zh: 雷劈在沼泽上，我缩进泥里。
lines.en: Lightning hits the swamp; I shrink into the mud.
The mud gave way and I fell.
